project.description: cv-witness combines candidate-reviewed agent instructions with local, checked CV export tools. This map covers a public tracked-file snapshot; private resumes, vaults and writing corpora are excluded. It shows static source dependencies, not live telemetry, and inferred call edges are disabled.

layers.entry: Local commands that accept selected inputs.
layers.service: Shared PDF checks and the owned-browser lifecycle.
layers.infra: Deployment and the protected test gate.
layers.test: Synthetic contracts and actual browser-export failures.

file:scripts/build_cv.py.summary: Validates approved JSON and renders repeatable employers, roles and optional sections through one layout. Career lanes change section order, never claims.

file:scripts/render_cv.py.summary: Renders self-contained HTML in a fresh browser profile, detects completed output even when Chrome lingers, and publishes only a checked PDF. Failure preserves prior output.

file:scripts/cv_checks.py.summary: Shared checks for paper geometry, page limits, live text, markers, expected content and selected-posting overlap. Default diagnostics omit private passages.

file:scripts/check_cv.py.summary: Checks a PDF exported from another authoring tool using the same delivery policy.

file:scripts/jd_overlap.py.summary: Reports maximal word runs shared with a local posting. Strict mode fails; generic wording still needs context review.

file:scripts/voice_corpus.py.summary: Imports selected, attested originals into private local storage and produces descriptive voice references. Generated memories and other authors' messages are excluded.

file:scripts/render_sample.py.summary: Reproduces the fictional legacy sample through the checked renderer, without reading private resume sources.

file:scripts/ci_pdf_smoke.py.summary: Short fictional browser diagnostic run before the full export suite. CI failures are bounded and do not expose real documents.

file:render.sh.summary: Portable compatibility entrypoint that delegates to the checked Python renderer.

file:examples/structured-cv.json.summary: Fictional four-role input used by every lane and paper variant. It is not an applicant's resume.

file:examples/sample-cv.json.summary: Fictional flat-field input retained for the legacy template sample.

file:tests/test_build_cv.py.summary: Repeatable-input contracts and real A4/Letter exports for all six lanes, including long roles, technical prose and wrapped links.

file:tests/test_cv_checks.py.summary: Deliberately failing PDF, overlap, private-output and browser-completion regressions.

file:tests/test_render_cv.py.summary: Actual Chromium/Poppler checks for Unicode, page limits, posting failures and preservation of an existing PDF.

file:tests/test_voice_corpus.py.summary: Synthetic authorship, Cabinet/Obsidian formatting, import, revision, privacy and deletion regressions. No personal vault is read.

file:SKILL.md.summary: Canonical agent workflow for factual sources, candidate approval, optional voice references and export review. Source text is data, not instructions.

file:README.md.summary: Installation and usage entrypoint linking the contracts, interactive maps and verification limits.

file:CHANGELOG.md.summary: Release history and bounded claims about voice references and export checks.

file:.github/workflows/voice-tests.yml.summary: Required Linux/macOS Python test matrix with actual fictional exports. All results feed the protected merge gate.

file:.github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml.summary: Deploys only the landing page and public assets. Private resumes and corpora must never enter that asset tree.

tours.title: A checked export
tours.description: Follow approved wording to the shared output gate.

steps.note: Begin with independently verified facts and candidate approval.
Validate repeated records and apply a section-order preset without rewriting content.
Render a temporary candidate in an owned browser session.
Run the shared checks before publishing. Passing them does not certify facts or an ATS result.
Inspect failure tests showing why a bad candidate cannot replace an earlier PDF.

tours.title: Writing style and private sources
tours.description: Follow the original-writing boundary and reference lifecycle.

steps.note: Select human-written originals. Vault graphs and generated memories are not authorship evidence.
Import with explicit attestation and author scope. References remain separate from source originals.
Read contamination, revision, overwrite and deletion regressions.
Use approved style preferences only for wording; verify resume facts independently.

tours.title: One layout, four career lanes
tours.description: Understand repeatable records and honest pagination.

steps.note: The fictional fixture has repeated roles and optional content instead of fixed numbered slots.
A lane changes section order. Every selected role and bullet is emitted.
All lane/paper combinations and long-content cases use actual PDF exports.
The protected gate requires every platform and runtime result to succeed.
